original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH date_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    d1.d_date_sk AS d1_date_sk,
    d1.d_date AS d1_date,
    d2.d_date_sk AS d2_date_sk
  FROM
    date_dim d1
    INNER JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
      AND d2.d_date_sk BETWEEN d1.d_date_sk AND (d1.d_date_sk + 30)
  WHERE
    d1.d_year = 2001
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
  SELECT
    ws_item_sk,
    ws_sold_date_sk,
    ws_bill_customer_sk,
    ws_warehouse_sk
  FROM
    web_sales
  WHERE
    ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT
    i_item_sk
  FROM
    item
  WHERE
    i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
  SELECT
    ca_address_sk
  FROM
    customer_address
  WHERE
    ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
),
warehouse_store AS (
  SELECT
    w_warehouse_sk,
    w_state
  FROM
    warehouse
    INNER JOIN store ON s_state = w_state
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  date_pairs
  INNER JOIN store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = date_pairs.d1_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_web_sales ON filtered_web_sales.ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND filtered_web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_pairs.d2_date_sk
  INNER JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    AND filtered_web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = filtered_customer_address.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN warehouse_store ON filtered_web_sales.ws_warehouse_sk = warehouse_store.w_warehouse_sk
  INNER JOIN inventory ON inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse_store.w_warehouse_sk
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
  cnt;

WITH
item_sub AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music') AND i_manager_id IN (6,10,21,31,34,57,70,73,85,96)
),
d1_sub AS (

),
d2_sub AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim
),
ss_sub AS (

ws_sub AS (

),

),
w_sub AS (

),

customer_sub AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk

  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

),
cd_sub AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics
),
hd_sub AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_vehicle_count FROM household_demographics
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ss_sub ss
JOIN item_sub i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN d1_sub d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN inv_sub inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
  AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN ws_sub ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
  AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN d2_sub d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)
JOIN customer_sub c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN w_sub w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN s_sub s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
JOIN cd_sub cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN hd_sub hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

    SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,

JOIN customer c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk

),

),

),
cross_items AS (

),
avg_sales_store AS (

    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM store_sales ss
      JOIN item iss ON ss.ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
      WHERE iss.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id

        AND iss.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
        AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM catalog_sales cs
      JOIN item ics ON cs.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
      WHERE ics.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
        AND ics.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
        AND ics.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
        AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM web_sales ws
      JOIN item iws ON ws.ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
      WHERE iws.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
        AND iws.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
        AND iws.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
        AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    )
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk,
         SUM(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale,
         SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit) AS refund
  FROM catalog_sales
  INNER JOIN catalog_returns
    ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
   AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY cs_item_sk
  HAVING SUM(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk,
         ss_ticket_number,
         ss_sold_date_sk,
         ss_store_sk,
         ss_customer_sk,
         ss_cdemo_sk,
         ss_hdemo_sk,
         ss_addr_sk,
         ss_promo_sk,
         ss_wholesale_cost,
         ss_list_price,
         ss_coupon_amt
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
filtered_promotion AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk,
         i_product_name,
         i_current_price
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk,
         cd_marital_status,
         cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
),
filtered_ca AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk,
         ca_street_number,
         ca_street_name,
         ca_city,
         ca_zip,
         ca_state
  FROM customer_address
),
cross_sales AS (
  SELECT i.i_product_name AS product_name,
         i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
         s.s_store_name AS store_name,
         s.s_zip AS store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
         d1.d_year AS syear,
         d2.d_year AS fsyear,
         d3.d_year AS s2year,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
         SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
         SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM filtered_store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  INNER JOIN cs_ui
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item i
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion p
    ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d1
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN store s
    ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN customer c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d2
    ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN date_dim d3
    ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd1
    ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd2
    ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
   AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1
    ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2
    ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_ca ad1
    ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_ca ad2
    ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
   AND ad2.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH')
  INNER JOIN income_band ib1
    ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  INNER JOIN income_band ib2
    ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  GROUP BY i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,
           d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year
)
SELECT cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 AS s11,
       cs1.s2 AS s21,
       cs1.s3 AS s31,
       cs2.s1 AS s12,
       cs2.s2 AS s22,
       cs2.s3 AS s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
INNER JOIN cross_sales cs2
  ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
 AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
 AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
 AND cs1.syear = 1999

 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
ORDER BY cs1.product_name,
         cs1.store_name,
         cs2.cnt,
         cs1.s1,

),
item_filter as (
  select i_item_sk

ssr as (
  select
    s.s_store_id as store_id,
    sum(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
    sum(ss.ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from store_sales ss
  inner join date_filter d on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  inner join store s on ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  inner join item_filter i on ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  inner join promo_filter p on ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  left outer join store_returns sr on (ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk and ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number)
  where ss.ss_wholesale_cost between 45 and 60
  group by s.s_store_id
),
csr as (
  select
    cp.cp_catalog_page_id as catalog_page_id,
    sum(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) as returns,
    sum(cs.cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from catalog_sales cs
  inner join date_filter d on cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  inner join catalog_page cp on cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  inner join item_filter i on cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  inner join promo_filter p on cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  left outer join catalog_returns cr on (cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk and cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number)
  where cs.cs_wholesale_cost between 45 and 60
  group by cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
  select
    ws_site.web_site_id,
    sum(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) as sales,
    sum(coalesce(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) as returns,
    sum(ws.ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) as profit
  from web_sales ws
  inner join date_filter d on ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  inner join web_site ws_site on ws.ws_web_site_sk = ws_site.web_site_sk
  inner join item_filter i on ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  inner join promo_filter p on ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  left outer join web_returns wr on (ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk and ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number)
  where ws.ws_wholesale_cost between 45 and 60
  group by ws_site.web_site_id
)

  sum(sales) as sales,
  sum(returns) as returns,
  sum(profit) as profit
from (
  select

    'store' || store_id as id,
    sales,
    returns,
    profit
  from ssr
  union all
  select
    'catalog channel' as channel,
    'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id as id,
    sales,
    returns,
    profit
  from csr
  union all
  select

WITH target_dates AS (

),
target_month_seq AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date IN ('2002-02-09', '2002-04-16', '2002-07-16', '2002-10-28')
),
filtered_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d
  INNER JOIN target_month_seq tms ON d.d_month_seq = tms.d_month_seq
),
sr_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns
  INNER JOIN item ON sr_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd ON sr_returned_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
    AND sr_return_amt / NULLIF(sr_return_quantity, 0) BETWEEN 271 AND 300
    AND sr_reason_sk IN (3, 20, 40, 43, 51)
  GROUP BY i_item_id
),
cr_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns
  INNER JOIN item ON cr_item_sk = i_item_sk

),
